# Trailforge

Trailforge is a trail running pure player with a huge athlete programme and race sponsorships (Lavaredo Ultra Trail). They rank top 3 for "trail running shoes" in English and Italian and publish shoe reviews weekly. Our Torrente line cannot compete head-on on the head term; the opportunity is long-tail (rocky terrain, via ferrata approach runs) and Dolomites race content. Domain: trailforge.com.
